title: Among Us Review 2026
content:
I love playing among us, but recently, I have noticed two errors that are slowly ruining the game.

However, when I try joining a new lobby, the server tells me I “intentionally disconnected” and I cannot play for X amount of minutes. It is frustrating because I am not disconnecting from my device. This makes me dislike the server moderation. 

The next issue is the “randomized” chances; I have seen numerous times the same people in the same role. X always gets imposter, and Y always gets crew mate Engineer with 20% chance.  Having the same people in the same roles ruins the game because it doesn’t allow everyone to discover other roles and to learn from roles, which will slowly ruin the game as well. 

These issues do NOT need to be fixed quickly, as I would rather know time and effort went into fixing the issues. 

Sincerely, 

The BEST detective,
